comment: Price / quota-weight table (SPEC §4). Devin CLI reports tokens but no USD amounts, so cost is estimated here. Models marked free:true are the permanent free tier (SWE-2 family on Pro+): they consume no paid quota (quotaWeight 0) and are accounted separately from paid usage. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, seeded from `devin models` output on 2026-11-20; edit freely.
